method: Static source audit only; no runtime, tests, network, git or shared inventory mutation.

files.finding: useStatusLabel → useIssueStatuses → issueStatusListOptions → api.listIssueStatuses(true). Built-in/category translation and entryOf lookup are local; duplicate entryOf fallback does not fetch.

useStatusOptions and useStatusLabel observe catalog; useIssueStatusOptions also observes workflow list for nonempty wsId and project list only with nonempty wsId/projectId. Sorting, archived inclusion, workflow step mapping and insertion of current Default status are local. null project selects Default; undefined returns catalog when no listed workflow. Query observers do not guarantee one HTTP request per hook invocation.

All exported functions are local synchronous category normalization, patch rewriting, set selection, sorting or predicates. pending/error are returned values, not requests. normalizeStatusPatch does not invalidate or refetch; downstream cache callers remain outside this file closure.

Identifier resolver enabled only enabled && !UUID && wsId && routeId; UUID detail enabled only enabled && canonicalId && wsId. Both use issueDetailOptions → api.getIssue(encoded id). initialData seeds canonical observer; effect setQueryData seeds identifier only if absent. These are cache operations, not HTTP. Read-state retry calls selected observer refetch({cancelRefetch:false}) only on uncached non-unavailable failure, not fetching, no same-scope retry pending. ApiError 401/403/404 becomes notFound; cached data prevents loadFailed. No absolute request-count claim: cache freshness and observer configuration matter.

Local contract fully read: inactive/defined data sources resolve, including stale data with error; false sources ignored. Undefined sources block; any failed undefined source wins over pending. retry invokes only captured failed unresolved sources, without awaiting/deduplicating/catching. combine retries captured error states only; statusCatalogSource forwards catalog.retry and exposes data only when loaded. Catalog retry closes through useIssueStatuses refetch → issueStatusListOptions → listIssueStatuses(true). Other injected callbacks require remaining caller closure described in markdown.

limitations: Generic non-catalog callback production closure remains partial; no global coverage promotion.
